Greetings, I am No Talent Redmage and I'm playing Titus The Fox for GameBoy Color or Game Boy, actually both since they are mostly the same game with the minor exception that if you played it on the Gameboy Color you got 2 extra stages, which makes no sense since the Gameboy had plenty of cart space for the whole 38kb the extra 2 stages take up. Pointless platform locking content aside the game is just a terrible rushed mess.

The game stars a fox, or more accurately 3 foxes and a cat. The game box arty fox is different than in game between stage fox iwhich is also vastly different than the Titus logo fox. It's almost like the artists didn't so much as see one another in the 2 weeks it took to slap this mess together, leaving the game with a skitzo protagonist. Then you have the game sprite which looks oddly like a discount Felix or Sylvester the cat.

The goal of the game is to rescue your girlfriend suzy from some unexplained evil(becuase you know easy plot is easy right?). The game makes no attempt to tell the story via gameplay which I can live with since many older games just opted to do that via those mystical things called instruction booklets.You know, that magical thing that came with games that most folks only skimmed through to maybe learn the controls and look at artwork? Yeah, those. The story isn't really the problem though. I can live with a generic story so long as the game play compensates in some manner, which it most certainly does not.

The problem with the game is it's entirely generic and slow paced, seriously, I have seen waterfalls made of maple syrup move faster than this game. You would think that It would be a simple left to right platformer for kids and well, you would be wrong, horribly wrong. See while the first stage of the game is a simple if dull left to right platformer, other stages have hidden exits that can only be activated by randomly walking over a spot to spawn a ladder or some other object.

The seems simple in theory, but its really dumb how it's implemented. There's really no clues in the stage or the ground as to where these hidden objects might be, which make It's far more a chore than entertaining. Maybe if there were some kind puzzle element or even a hot/ cold system in the game to find these it wouldn't be such a hassle. What you get is essentially Milons Secret Castle with worse sprites(partial hyperbole in case you missed that). It's a game obviously marketed to kids, but even as an adult I have no clue as to what random block im supposed to stand on to move forward. Battletoads is less frustrating and that game is harder than dinosuar shit rolled in titanium.

Which brings me to the graphics. While the sprites are detailed they all have this funky outline that makes them all look like paper cutouts which I guess was an attempt to make the character pop, but instead just highlights how little work was put into arguably the most one of the most important parts of the game; enemies and animation. Most enemies just walk/fly back and forth with all of 2 frames of animation.

While I can agree the enemies are detailed enough what I don't get is why they all look like they are just skating around the like some abomination cross breeding experiement between Popeye and Disneys on ice series. The hitboxes are not much better, sometimes I would have an enemy fly right through the ears on my sprite while othertimes register a hit just for so much as an ear touching a projectile. Same can be said while collecting ...triagle things in the air. Which by the way you can't tell how much health you have left unless you puase the game, same can be said for the boxed triangles that give you extra lives (not that you really need it as the games more of a test on your sanity then actual skill).

The platforming and enemies are also boring. You can't jump on them to kill them, your only mode of attack being finding a box and tossing it at them. Your cat sprite also jumps like he's partially filled with hydrogen gas, which would be amazing if he exploded in a fiery ball of death like the Hindenberg which sadly he does not because Thor forbid something in this train wreck be redeemable. Even the enemies refuse to be entertaining and the few that might have had interesting mechanics kind of just sit there being about as threatening as 400 lb man vs a mob of zombies (Or more accurately, about as threatening as Jim Sterling).

Example, skeletons on the second stage just walk back and forth, no projectiles or life in them(pun not intended) which is essentially all the enmies in game. They all just walk a set path in hopes that you run into them, most of them with expressiosn on thier faces that look more like "I don't know where the nearest Wendys is" rather than outright murder. The few enemies that could have been good like the ghosts on stage 2 kind of just sit there after turning solid, like they lost the will to live...again.

The sound is also dreary and uninspired the loops typically only lasted maybe 34 seconds at most before repeating. Even the sound effects are dull, no barking dogs or ghost sounds, not even the drunken guy on the ground, tossing bottles at you utters a word. Just boring, dull as watching wallpaper dry platforming.

The game just screams cheap cash in and after a few minutes looking around on the net I found out it is exactly that. The original game came out on PC's in 1991 under the name Lagaf': Les Aventures de Moktar — Vol 1: La Zoubida, a French game based on a comedian I have never heard of (sorry France). They changed around a few sprites and released it nearly a decade later under the name of the company Mascot. You know, by cutting down the game significantly and rearranging the sprites to make new stages. The original game had dorrways and mazelike elements and you could even toss enemies at other enemies. It wasn't too much better than this title, but they are least tried with it.

The entire game is just a massive waste of time and space(Also like Jim Sterling). A quick uninspired cash grab targeting grandmas everywhere to accidentally pick this game up for thier grandkids bday/x-mas gift.

The best way to describe the game is a rushed mess best forgotten. Only play if you're into tourturing yourself.

I have been No Talent Redmage and this has been discount felix the cat. I'll see ya next time.
